protocol: Third-party agentic benchmark. AgentHarm supplies the attack prompts, the distribution-matched harmless_benign control prompts over the same tool surface, and the ground-truth target_functions each prompt is meant to drive. An independent model -- shown no guard source, no manifest and no mention of a guard -- supplied the per-function destructive/outward label. Every call is checked with its verb explicitly GRANTED, so capability reservation cannot do the work. All 85 functions are foreign to the guard's manifest, so only the heuristic tier and the fail-closed rule for undeclared verbs are under test; the manifest tier is deliberately not given the answers.

no_guard_baseline.note: With no guard every target call executes.
